```artifact
Feature: System Availability and Backup

  Scenario: System Availability
    Given the system is operational
    When the system is under normal load
    Then the system availability should be 99.999%

  Scenario: Outage Window
    Given the system is operational
    When the current day is a Sunday and it's the second Sunday of the month
    Then the system should be down for 10 minutes

  Scenario: Nightly Full Backup
    Given the system is operational
    When the current time is midnight
    Then a full backup should be performed

  Scenario: Monthly Rollback Provision
    Given the system is operational
    When a month has passed
    Then the system should be rolled back by one month

  Scenario: Backup Restoration on Dummy Production System
    Given a backup has been performed
    When the backup is restored on a dummy production system
    Then the backup should be complete and correct

  Scenario: Purge Dummy Production Database
    Given a backup has been restored on a dummy production system
    When the backup restoration is complete
    Then the dummy production database should be purged

  Scenario: Confidential Data Storage
    Given the system is operational
    When confidential data is stored
    Then the data should be maintained in a fireproof cabinet 25 KM away from the Hospital

  Scenario: Compliance with Healthcare Regulations
    Given the system is operational
    When the system is used
    Then it should comply with health care regulations as defined by the Government of India
```
